title: Fix timing-flaky terminal_titles provider-process tests
body: terminal_titles::tests::provider_process_is_bounded_and_scrubs_hook_routing and provider_process_falls_back_to_safe_windows_cmd_shim (src/terminal_titles.rs) unwrap Err(Timeout) on their happy-path run_process calls (cmd echo, the .cmd shim) under a 2s ceiling. Failed 2 of 5 full-suite runs under double load. That 2s is only a don't-hang ceiling, not a speed claim; production uses PROCESS_TIMEOUT=30s for a background model call. Fix: raise the happy-path and exit-7 ceilings to about 10s. Keep the real bounds as they are: the 50ms timeout cases and the 750ms stdin-inside-deadline assert. Split the bundled test into its four claims (env scrub, slow provider killed, blocked stdin bounded, nonzero exit -> Failed) so a slow echo can't hide the others. Keep the shim's injection-refusal assert (BatBadBut class). No product change expected.
